Name: Kittens
Author: Riazaia
Description:
[size=3]This mod uses [b]Content Patcher[/b] to change the appearance of yout pet cat. It replaces all three cat skins available in vanilla. 

[color=#ff0000][b]new![/b] [/color]Added a config option to have your kittens grow in Year 2! 

I'd love to hear any thoughts, comments or suggestions. I hope you like it![/size]

[b][size=4]How to Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[*][size=4]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[*][size=4]Download, unzip and put the resulting folder inside Mods folder. It should look like this: [/size][...]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Kittens
[*][size=4]If you want your kittens to grow into adults by Year 2, open the [i]config.json[/i] and change the [b]false[/b] value to [b]true[/b]. The config file gets generated once your run the game with this mod installed. It can be found in the [CP] Kittens folder.[/size]
[*][size=4]Enjoy![/size]
[/list]
[left]
[/left]
